name: ephpm/switchboard-api
description: GitHub webhook receiver for ePHPm PR previews — a PSR-15 application that runs as a confined vhost inside ePHPm and hands jobs to the switchboard daemon.

suggest.ephpm/psr15-worker: Run this app under ePHPm persistent worker mode. Opt-in — see the README; fpm mode is the default and is what the webhook path is tuned for.
